claim: Relaxed soundness is an upper bound on true soundness for gadgets in Max-2Lin(2) reductions.
falsifier: For any given gadget, compute both true soundness and relaxed soundness and verify that relaxed soundness is an upper bound.

conditions: The gadget reduction is from a Hadamard Max-CSP to Max-2Lin(2)
The relaxed soundness is defined as a less constrained maximization problem
exclusions: Evidence is limited to the reported gadget constructions and analysis; transfer beyond them is unestablished.

title: Gadget reductions for Max-2Lin–Upper bound on true theorem
